title: Grand Touring
sources:
- Lincoln Corsair: https://www.lincoln.com/luxury-suvs/corsair/
- Edmunds 2025 PHEV specs: https://www.edmunds.com/lincoln/corsair/2025/plug-in-hybrid/st-402038114/features-specs/
- IIHS 2025 Corsair: https://www.iihs.org/ratings/vehicle/lincoln/corsair-4-door-suv/2025
- Clean Charge Network: https://cleanchargenetwork.com/ev-model/2025-lincoln-corsair-grand-touring-plug-in-hybrid/
- Top Electric SUV review: https://topelectricsuv.com/reviews/lincoln-corsair-grand-touring-phev/
infotainment: SYNC 4 with 13.2-inch center touchscreen, wireless Apple CarPlay / Android Auto, Revel 14-speaker audio standard (Revel Ultima 28-speaker optional)
adasStandard: Lincoln Co-Pilot360 2.0 (Pre-Collision Assist with Automatic Emergency Braking, Blind Spot Information System with Cross-Traffic Alert, Lane-Keeping System, Auto High-Beam Headlamps, Rear View Camera, Reverse Sensing System). BlueCruise hands-free highway driving standard on Grand Touring (4-year complimentary Connected Service plan). Source: https://www.lincoln.com/luxury-suvs/corsair/
adasOptional: Active Park Assist 2.0, Adaptive Pixel LED headlamps, 360-degree camera. Source: https://www.edmunds.com/lincoln/corsair/2025/plug-in-hybrid/
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard rear-view camera with dynamic guidelines. Available 360-degree camera with split-view display. Source: https://www.lincoln.com/luxury-suvs/corsair/
sideViewCameraNotes: 360-degree surround-view camera available as part of the Grand Touring's standard equipment, providing top-down composite view from four exterior cameras. No Honda LaneWatch-style side-blind camera. Source: https://www.edmunds.com/lincoln/corsair/2025/plug-in-hybrid/st-402038114/features-specs/
subscriptionFeatures: BlueCruise hands-free driving (4-year complimentary, then ~$75/month or $800/year per Ford/Lincoln pricing). SiriusXM 360L (trial period then subscription). In-vehicle WiFi hotspot via AT&T (trial then subscription). Lincoln Way app remote features (complimentary for life of vehicle as of 2025). Heated seats, ventilated seats, and other comfort features are NOT subscription-gated. Source: https://www.lincoln.com/support/how-tos/lincoln-technology/driver-assist-features/lincoln-bluecruise-frequently-asked-questions/
drmNotes: Core vehicle functions (drive, climate, audio via USB/Bluetooth) operate without internet. Connected features requiring active subscription: BlueCruise hands-free driving, remote start/lock/status via Lincoln Way app, OTA updates, in-vehicle WiFi hotspot, SiriusXM with 360L. BlueCruise comes with 4-year complimentary Connected Service; renewal required after that. No documented cases of post-sale remote disabling of paid features. Source: https://www.lincoln.com/technology/connected-services/
killSwitchNotes: No federal impaired-driving-detection kill switch installed in MY2025; NHTSA final rule not yet published. Driver Alert System (drowsiness detection from steering inputs) and BlueCruise's driver-facing IR camera (eye-gaze/head-pose monitoring) are present but only suppress hands-free mode, do not disable the vehicle. Source: https://www.lincoln.com/support/how-tos/lincoln-technology/driver-assist-features/lincoln-bluecruise-frequently-asked-questions/
knownIssues: Owner forums report occasional 12V battery drain when vehicle sits unused for extended periods (common Ford PHEV complaint), eCVT shudder under aggressive launch from low SOC, and infotainment freezes resolved by reboot. Source: https://lincolnforums.com/
recalls: NHTSA recall 24V-577 (Aug 2024): Battery energy control module software may misreport battery state, potential stall — software flash remedy. Other open recalls per https://www.nhtsa.gov/recalls
stateIncentives: Final-assembly in Louisville, KY meets IRA North-America assembly rule, but battery component / critical-minerals sourcing has not qualified the 2025 Corsair Grand Touring PHEV for the $7,500 IRC 30D consumer credit per IRS Qualified Vehicle list. Leasing through Lincoln AFS may pass through the $7,500 commercial 45W credit as a lease incentive. State incentives: CA CVRP closed in 2023; CO has up to $5,000 state EV tax credit through 2025 for PHEVs; NJ sales-tax exemption applies to BEVs only (not PHEV). Sources: https://www.fueleconomy.gov/feg/taxevb.shtml , https://fueleconomy.gov/feg/tax2023.shtml

subscriptionFeatures: BlueCruise (4-yr complimentary then ~$75/mo). SiriusXM 360L (trial). 4G WiFi via AT&T (trial). Heated/ventilated seats NOT subscription-gated. drmNotes: Vehicle drives without internet connectivity. Source: https://www.lincoln.com/technology/connected-services/
killSwitchNotes: No federal impaired-driving-detection kill switch in MY2025. Standard driver-facing IR camera (BlueCruise) monitors gaze/head pose for hands-free attention only — does not disable vehicle.
